awards_coaches.why: One row per award given to a coach in a year; points at the coach's season in coaches.

awards_players.why: One row per award given to a player in a year, keyed player, year and award; points at players.

coaches.why: A coach's record with one team in one season, keyed coach, year, team and stint; points at that team-season.

draft.why: One row per draft pick in a draft year, naming the selecting team and the player picked.

player_allstar.why: A player's stat line in one season's all-star game (games_played is always 1), keyed player and season.

players.why: One row per player with names, birth details and school; every player table points at it.

players_teams.why: A player's season statistics with one team, keyed by player, year and stint; the year repeats across rows.

series_post.why: One playoff series in a year, pointing at the winning and losing team-season.

teams.why: A team's record for one season, keyed year and team; coaches, draft, series and player stints point at it.
